jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Data and Platform Tools – Bloomberg Connects
jobs.description:
Location

New York

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10054281

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Connects is a rapidly growing, free platform that helps museums, galleries, and cultural spaces make their institutions, stories and dynamic content more engaging to audiences around the world. Launched in 2019, Connects features multimedia guides with unique content exclusive to each of our over 1,500 cultural institution partners across 33 countries.

As part of Bloomberg's culture of giving back, Connects is a joint effort between Bloomberg and Bloomberg Philanthropies in support of their work to ensure better, longer lives for the greatest number of people by focusing on five key areas: the arts, education, the environment, government innovation, and public health.

We believe that technology opens doors, and we created Connects as a part of our mission to make art and culture accessible to all—in-person, at-home, and anywhere.

We are a team of designers, researchers, marketers, editors, engineers, and leaders working together to enhance our partner's capacity to reach audiences around the world and improve their visitor experience. Built through empathy and research, qualitative and quantitative data, and experimentation and iteration, our products seek to delight and empower.

The Data and Platform Tools team builds and runs the services behind the platform's analytics, search, speech, computer vision, generative AI, and agentic systems. We are looking for a senior engineer to own the infrastructure those services are built on.

What's in it for you?

Own systems end to end:
Design, build and operate the services behind Connects' analytics, search, speech, computer vision, and AI features, from architecture through to what runs in production.

Work on AI systems in production:
Build and run the infrastructure behind our LLM-based and agentic features, from deployment through evaluation.

Work the way we're building toward:
Use AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices in your own daily work, and help build the internal platform and tooling other disciplines rely on to do the same.

Shape how we build:
Establish the infrastructure, deployment and delivery patterns our services are built on.

Shape global cultural engagement:
Directly impact how millions access and experience art and culture through a rapidly expanding platform.

Contribute to a philanthropic mission:
Align your work with a meaningful initiative supporting arts and cultural accessibility.

We'll Trust You To

Design, build and operate the distributed services that power Connects' analytics, search, speech, computer vision, generative AI, and agentic systems
Build and maintain the infrastructure that runs our AI features in production
Contribute directly to our agentic core platform and tooling — used across engineering and, increasingly, every discipline on the product team
Own the deployment, release and delivery pipelines our services depend on, and raise the standard of how we ship
Take architectural decisions that carry real weight, and distribute that knowledge across the team
Partner with engineering teams across Connects — backend/api, mobile and web teams — on the interfaces and infrastructure our systems share
Participate in a cross-functional agile team spanning design and engineering

You'll Need To Have

5+ years of professional experience designing, developing and releasing high-quality software in Python, C++, C# and/or TypeScript/JavaScript
A Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or equivalent work experience

We’d Love To See

Google Cloud Platform — BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Composer, Artifact Registry
Infrastructure as code, particularly Terraform
Designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including Jenkins
Designing, building and operating distributed systems and services in production
Owning services across their full lifecycle — architecture, deployment, operation and evolution — rather than handing them off
Proficiency in Python
Working with cloud platforms and cloud-native services
Containerized workloads and orchestration
Real, current use of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools in your own work — this is how the team operates, not an occasional aid
Setting technical direction and working independently
Building or operating LLM and agent systems in production, including evaluation frameworks
Experience working in a compiled language such as Go, Rust, C++, etc.
Search infrastructure and indexing pipelines
Vector embeddings/databases and Retrieval Augmented Generation
Speech (TTS/STT) or computer vision systems in production

Salary Range = 160,000 - 240,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Platform (Core AI Automation)
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform Core Automation team, you'll build the AI infrastructure and agentic systems that automate customer support and compliance operations at Coinbase. This team is reimagining what these processes look like when AI handles them end-to-end, replacing manual workflows with intelligent agents that resolve customer issues and execute compliance tasks autonomously. You'll own the design and delivery of LLM-powered systems, grounding techniques, and integration pipelines that directly reduce resolution times, cut costs, and improve accuracy across millions of customer interactions.
What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

Own the design and delivery of agentic AI systems that power Coinbase's customer support and compliance automation, from LLM orchestration through production deployment and monitoring.
Build scalable, secure backend infrastructure in Python and Golang that serves AI workloads, including model integration pipelines, guardrails, grounding mechanisms, and measurement frameworks.
Drive end-to-end project execution on complex AI initiatives, making technical trade-offs across latency, accuracy, cost, and reliability.
Partner with Customer Experience, Compliance, and product engineering teams to identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate operational pain points into AI-powered solutions.
Strengthen engineering quality across the team by leading code reviews, mentoring engineers on AI system design patterns, and contributing to on-call rotations and incident response.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

5+ years of experience in software engineering, with proven expertise in designing, building, and maintaining production services using a microservices architecture.
Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications or AI/ML systems in production, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agentic AI frameworks.
Proficiency in Python and Golang (or comparable backend languages), with experience integrating third-party AI models and APIs into production workflows.
Track record of delivering end-to-end projects with measurable business impact in ambiguous problem spaces.
Experience building data pipelines, integrating with external vendors, or working with large-scale unstructured data sources (e.g., blockchain data, customer interaction logs).
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Nice to haves:

Experience navigating rapid company growth (e.g., from startup to mid-size).
Familiarity with GenAI frameworks/tools, Python, GoLang, Docker, Postgres, MongoDB.
Background in AI/LLM infrastructure is a strong plus.

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).  
Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):: $186,065 USD - $218,900 USD
Application Limit:
Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
US Applicants:
View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation.
Accommodations:
If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the
tutorial.
Data Privacy & Arbitration:
By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Develop custom software solutions within an Agile development framework.
• Configure, analyze, and maintain program code to support business functions and minimize technical debt.
• Design efficient database structures, potentially translating logical models to physical designs.
• Ensure seamless integration between various applications and critical systems.
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with a focus on thorough resolution.
• Document key work and maintain a strong understanding of assigned applications and projects.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent experience.
• 2+ years of professional experience in software development.
• Demonstrable experience with Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Hibernate, HTML5, and Web Services.
• Proficiency in JavaScript and web development technologies.
• Intermediate SQL skills and experience with relational databases.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.

What's On Offer
• Competitive annual salary ($89,400 - $134,000) plus potential for flexible paid time off.
• Comprehensive benefits including paid holidays, wellness days, and various leave options.
• Opportunities for professional development and to work with cutting-edge technologies.
• A dynamic environment where collaboration and continuous learning are highly valued.

Apply via Haystack today!
